method: Within each date, linearly map original H1 prices from intraday minimum/maximum to the Chartix daily low/high. Set first H1 open to daily open and last H1 close to daily close. Scale H1 volumes proportionally to daily volume and put rounding remainder in final bar. No previous-close/next-open bridging is applied.
validation: Re-aggregated adjusted H1 candles match the Chartix daily OHLCV exactly for every included day.
limitations: Synthetic reconstruction, not actual trade-level candles.
Intraday timing/order of daily high and low is not independently verified.
Two dates were left unchanged because the daily reference was absent or invalid.
Original Chartix export and TSETMC-validated baseline remain untouched.
